newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania rises on relief over Q1 report.
newsitem.headline: Scania rises on relief over Q1 report.

text.p: Shares in Swedish truck maker Scania rose on the Stockholm stock exchange after the company released first quarter earnings.
At 1425 GMT, the share was changing hands at 189 crowns, up 0.5 crowns after having been lower earlier in the day.
Scania's first quarter profit almost halved to 577 million crowns, lower than the 608 million crowns which was forecast in a Reuter poll of analysts.
"First the share fell on the report but then the market changed its mind and the share rose in relief that the report was not worse," a trader said.
"Many had worried that the report would be really bad, partly because Volvo Trucks showed a poor result."
